# Helm Terminal

> Helm Terminal is an AI-powered financial intelligence platform for retail investors. It connects to your brokerage via Plaid, pulls live market data, and produces automated stock analysis, risk signals, tax-loss harvesting recommendations, and portfolio intelligence. Built for individual investors who want institutional-grade insight without the five-figure annual cost of a wealth manager.

## What Helm does

- AI stock analysis with live risk signals for any US-listed stock or ETF (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX). Free, no signup required at /analyze/[ticker].
- Automated portfolio analysis via secure Plaid brokerage connection.
- Tax-loss harvesting opportunity detection with wash-sale awareness.
- Real-time market data, price alerts, and earnings exposure tracking.
- Sector comparison and similar-stock discovery.
- Personalized AI synthesis for each holding in your portfolio.
- Cash flow monitoring and net worth tracking across linked accounts.
- Actions Inbox that prioritizes what matters in your financial system this week.

## Who Helm is for

- Individual retail investors managing their own portfolios across one or more brokerage accounts.
- DIY investors who want professional-grade analysis without paying for a financial advisor.
- Founders, engineers with RSUs, finance professionals, and high-agency users who want data-driven financial intelligence.
- People who want tax optimization without hiring a CPA.
- Investors managing $50K–$2M+ across multiple accounts who need consolidated intelligence.

## Freshness model

Helm's stock analyses reflect live market dynamics. Cached analyses refresh every 30 minutes during US market hours (9:30am–4:00pm ET, Mon–Fri), and every 24 hours off-hours. Every analysis page displays a visible "last updated" timestamp and a collapsible methodology disclosure showing data sources and pipeline version. This is YMYL content — provenance is never hidden.

## How analyses are generated

Live market data (price, fundamentals, analyst consensus, recent news, earnings history) is pulled from Finnhub and passed to OpenAI's GPT-4o-mini with a specialized equity-research system prompt. The model produces a structured JSON response containing: verdict (bullish/bearish/neutral), summary, bull case, bear case, key metrics, recommendation, and news highlights. Every analysis is unique to the ticker and the moment it was computed. No templates.

## Pricing

Free tier: unlimited free AI stock analysis for any US-listed ticker at /analyze. No signup required, no credit card, no email gate.

Paid tier: connect your brokerage, get portfolio-level AI analysis, tax-loss harvesting signals, risk alerts, and the full Actions Inbox. See /pricing for current plans.

## Tech stack

Next.js (App Router), Supabase (Postgres + Auth + RLS), Plaid (brokerage/bank linking), Polygon.io (market data), Finnhub (fundamentals), OpenAI GPT-4o-mini (analysis pipeline), Tailwind CSS, deployed on Vercel.

## Security

Credentials never touch Helm's servers — brokerage linking goes through Plaid with the same security model used by Venmo, Robinhood, and Coinbase. Row-level security on all user data. No training of AI models on user portfolio data.

## Compliance & disclaimer

Helm Terminal is not a registered investment advisor. All analyses are AI-generated informational content, not personalized financial advice. Helm does not execute trades, hold custody of assets, or recommend specific securities to individuals. Users should consult a licensed financial advisor before making investment decisions.

## Founder

Helm Terminal is a solo-founded, self-funded project. Built because the founder had a portfolio spread across multiple accounts and realized institutional-grade analysis was locked behind five-figure annual fees — and thought it should be free or nearly free.
